name: Luca
description: Luca is a bimanual teleoperated robotic microsurgery platform developed by AcuSurgical (Montpellier, France) for vitreoretinal ophthalmic surgery. The system comprises two independent patient-side robotic manipulators positioned on either side of the patient's head that hold standard intraocular micro-instruments, controlled from an ergonomic surgeon piloting console. The platform provides physiological tremor filtering, motion scaling, and active gravity compensation while operating alongside a surgical microscope or 3D heads-up visualization display. A first-in-human clinical study evaluating safety and feasibility in vitreoretinal procedures was completed in 2024.
